$schema.description: Editor hint only; ignored by the loader.

id.description: The lock id keys name in `key.opens`.

notes.description: Where it is and what opens it, for owner review.

tier.description: How good the lock is, 0 (a latch) … 5 (a vault).

pickTier.description: Lockpicking tier needed to pick it (the minigame is mw-e10); null: it cannot be picked.

sealed.description: A magical seal: keys and picks fail until a spell dispels it.

tags.description: Tags a master key (`key.opensTag`) opens, e.g. "warden-tower".

hint.description: Shown when Interact finds no way past it, e.g. "Locked."
